newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk court rejects halting Eregli sale.
newsitem.headline: Turk court rejects halting Eregli sale.

text.p: A Turkish administrative court on Thursday rejected an application to halt the sell-off tender for majority state-owned flat steel producer Eregli Demir ve Celik Fabrikalari, the state-run Anatolian news agency said.
KIGEM, a non-governmental organisation for development of management in state enterprises, had in January sought the cancellation of the tender.
A Privatisation Administration (OIB) tender for the block sale of a 30-40 percent Eregli stake closed on January 27 with two bids received from local firms.
The court refused KIGEM's request to freeze the sell-off process after hearing the OIB's defence, the agency said.
The court will continue to review the case, it said.
The state holds a 51.66 percent stake in Eregli.
